Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq rises while S&P, Dow dip as softer inflation cools Fed hike bets
Markets.summary: On Wednesday, the Nasdaq rose while the Dow and S&P 500 dipped as softer inflation data cooled expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. Despite the daily declines, the Dow and S&P 500 both posted quarterly gains as private employers added 90,000 jobs in September.

Markets.title: France’s 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987
Markets.summary: France's 10-year bond yields are experiencing their largest quarterly surge since 1987 due to rising energy costs and inflation concerns. This upward pressure on interest rates is expected to continue as the government plans to issue €340 billion in bonds next year.

Markets.title: Polymarket introduces deposit limits, lock-outs to combat trading addiction
Markets.summary: Polymarket has introduced optional deposit limits and self-imposed lock-outs to help users control excessive trading habits. The startup is also partnering with Birches Health to provide mental health support resources for users.

Markets.title: Indian rupee rebounds to 95.83 vs US dollar as crude prices ease
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened 0.16% to 95.83 against the US dollar as crude oil prices dropped below $103 a barrel. This recovery was further supported by dollar selling from public sector banks and gains in broader Asian currencies despite foreign investor outflows.

Markets.title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns
Markets.summary: The SEC has proposed rules allowing more professionals to qualify as accredited investors, expanding retail access to private assets. Critics warn this change could expose everyday investors to higher fees and significant financial risks.

Markets.title: ElevenLabs' valuation doubles to $22 billion on surging AI voice-agent demand
Markets.summary: ElevenLabs achieved a $22 billion valuation through a recent employee tender offer backed by investors including Wellington, T. Rowe Price, and Andreessen Horowitz. This valuation doubles the company's worth from its previous funding round in February, driven by high demand for its voice technology.

Geo-Political.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
Geo-Political.summary: A Flydubai pilot was arrested and questioned after allegedly stabbing another pilot. The incident occurred during a flight to Israel, according to officials.

Geo-Political.title: Six smugglers jailed for manslaughter over worst Channel small boats disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Six smugglers were convicted of manslaughter and jailed for their roles in a November 2021 Channel crossing disaster. The incident resulted in the deaths of 31 migrants when their overloaded boat sank.

Geo-Political.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
Geo-Political.summary: The UK and France have scrapped a "one in, one out" migrant scheme that had been in place for just over a year. Since the program began, approximately 1,500 people have been removed to France.

Geo-Political.title: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike's scheduled execution for the 1995 murder of Colleen Slemmer was halted shortly before it was set to take place. Pike had been convicted and sentenced to death in 1996.

Geo-Political.title: Trekkers helicoptered off mountains as more deadly landslides hit Nepal
Geo-Political.summary: Around 30 people have died in Nepal due to heavy rain and landslides occurring a month after mass catastrophic flooding. Rescue operations successfully helicoptered stranded trekkers off the mountains.

Geo-Political.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight, Russia launched its largest attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure since the spring, targeting 11 regions. The strikes also hit residential buildings and railways, according to the Ukrainian Prime Minister.

Data & Insights.title: Govt keeps small savings rates unchanged for December quarter
Data & Insights.summary: The government has kept interest rates on twelve small savings schemes unchanged for the eleventh consecutive quarter. This decision relies on steady collections to help fund the fiscal deficit despite rising bond yields.

Data & Insights.title: India's fiscal deficit widens to  ₹7.1 lakh crore, hits 41.9% of FY27 target by August
Data & Insights.summary: India's fiscal deficit widened to ₹7.1 lakh crore by August, reaching 41.9% of the government's full-year target for FY27. This is higher than the 38.1% deficit recorded during the same period in the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: Indian economy fares better in August but renewed worries linger
Data & Insights.summary: India's economic indicators improved in August due to increased vehicle sales, credit growth, a stronger rupee, and a reduced trade deficit. However, new geopolitical risks threaten to slow this economic momentum.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's commitment to buy 10 million tonnes of US coal provides American miners with a new export market. This agreement also helps Beijing offer strategic concessions during broader trade negotiations with Washington.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the US and Europe. However, he stated that the EU must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors before that can happen.

India.title: Meghalaya Deputy Chief Minister Backs Review of Foreign Funding Bill
India.summary: Meghalaya Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong supports reviewing the foreign funding bill. He stated that the concerns of NGOs and Christian organizations should be considered during this scrutiny process.

India.title: BJP Kerala Headquarters Attacked, Party Calls For Statewide Agitation
India.summary: The Kerala headquarters of the BJP was attacked under the cover of darkness. In response to the incident, the party has called for a statewide agitation.

India.title: Drug-Free Punjab By 2029-End: Amit Shah's Big Promise Ahead Of Polls
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah promised to make Punjab drug-free by the end of 2029 during a BJP rally in Jalandhar. He also appealed to the state's youth to vote for the BJP ahead of the polls.

India.title: 19-Year-Old Student Stabbed To Death Outside College In Bengaluru
India.summary: A 19-year-old first-year B.Com student named Yogesh was stabbed to death outside his college in Nagarabhavi, Bengaluru. Police are investigating the incident to determine the motive and apprehend the attacker.

India.title: Delhi AQI Slips To 'Moderate' As Stubble Burning Reported In 6 States
India.summary: Between September 15 and 30, a total of 114 residue-burning events were detected across six states, causing Delhi's Air Quality Index to slip to 'moderate'. The highest number of stubble-burning incidents was recorded in Punjab with 59 cases, followed by Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.

India.title: AAP Takes "Chitta" Swipe at BJP As Amit Shah Holds Rally In Punjab, Congress Slams Them Both
India.summary: Punjab AAP chief Aman Arora criticized the BJP's "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra" during Amit Shah's rally, highlighting the BJP's past governance with the Shiromani Akali Dal regarding the state's drug issue. Meanwhile, the Congress party also condemned both the BJP and AAP.

General.title: Veteran broadcaster Dame Esther Rantzen dies aged 86
General.summary: Veteran broadcaster and Childline founder Dame Esther Rantzen has died at the age of 86. She famously hosted the BBC programme That's Life for twenty years and later campaigned for assisted dying.

General.title: Dame Esther Rantzen: A presenter who campaigned for change
General.summary: Dame Esther Rantzen is a veteran broadcaster known for her extensive career in television presenting, street interviews, and emotional reunion shows. She is also recognized for leading major national campaigns that drove social change.

General.title: US Supreme Court allows execution of Christa Pike to go ahead
General.summary: The US Supreme Court permitted the execution of Christa Pike to proceed via lethal injection. This ruling came after an appeals court had earlier halted the scheduled Wednesday execution.

General.title: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, PM says
General.summary: The UK prime minister stated that the British government believes Iran was involved in an incident at RAF Fairford. In response, Iran's foreign minister denied the accusation and stated that the prime minister was "barking up the wrong tree."

General.title: Conservatives pledge 'tough love' benefit rules for under-25s
General.summary: The party says it would bring in new work requirements for young people claiming Universal Credit.

General.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
